faq.question: What does Yusufi mean?
faq.answer: Yusufi is associated with the Arabic form يُوسُفِي, whose core sense is yusufi; of joseph (swahili form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Yusufi?
faq.answer: Yusufi is associated with Arabic. Yusufi is the Swahili relative form of Arabic يُوسُف (Yūsuf), the Quranic form of the prophet Joseph.

faq.question: Is Yusufi an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form يُوسُفِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Yusufi an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Yusufi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Yusufi a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Yusufi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Yūsuf is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Joseph and occurs in the Quran.

faq.answer: In Urdu, Yusufi is rendered یوسفی and carries the sense یوسفی، یوسف سے منسوب.

faq.question: What does Yusufi mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Yusufi is rendered یوسفی and carries the sense یوسفی، منسوب به یوسف.

faq.question: How is Yusufi pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is yu-su-fi. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Yusufi?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Yusufi, yusufi. Script forms are يوسفي, يُوسُفِي, یوسفی, युसुफ़ी.

faq.answer: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
